_doc: USGS 3DEP bare-earth elevation (m, NAVD88) every 2 m along the Denver Grand Prix lap on OSM's lines, from S/F round to S/F. s = metres from the Colfax / Sherman crosswalk; x, y = metres east / north of it. BARE EARTH: bridges read the ground beneath them. Not smoothed. Script: source/elevation/lap_profile.py.
